name: Predictive Loading
description: Learns which page you open next on each site from your own history and loads it early. No network calls, no tracking.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
